overview_description.description: Finyal Media is a podcast network that produces content for young Arabs all over the world. The mission of their company is to tell stories that help young people reconnect with their community. They believe that the current media landscape does not champion their local culture in a modern, relatable way to the younger generation, and their podcasts aim to fill that void.
